description.p: xl is a native spreadsheet for Linux. It opens and saves Excel workbooks and CSV files, and recalculates only what changed, so edits show up instantly even in large sheets.

ul.li: Formulas with Excel syntax, cross-sheet references and 77 functions
Number formats, cell styles and multiple sheets, round-tripped through .xlsx
Excel keyboard shortcuts, point-to-reference formula entry and a command palette
Autosave with crash recovery

screenshot.caption: A budget with live totals for the selected cells
Writing a formula, with each reference highlighted in the grid
Every command a keystroke away in the command palette

ul.li: Dynamic arrays: formulas spill, with FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, SEQUENCE and more, plus LET and LAMBDA
Printing and PDF export with page setup, print preview and page breaks
Charts: combos, secondary axis, trendlines, error bars, styling, histogram and waterfall
Pivot tables: calculated fields, grouping, slicers, timelines and pivot charts
Over 16 million rows, very fast CSV opening without mangling data, and SQL queries over sheets and CSV files
Sandboxed Lua scripting for custom functions and macros
Version history with cell-by-cell diffs, and git-friendly xlsx diffs

description.p: Lossless xlsx and a Home page:

ul.li: Saving an opened xlsx file changes only what you edited: themes, formatting, pictures, pivot tables, macros and everything else xl doesn't model are kept
Inserted and deleted rows, moved cells and renamed sheets are followed everywhere in the file
Charts, tables and sparklines you add, move or edit are written into the original file
Notes, hyperlinks and data validation with dropdown lists: read, shown, editable and saved
Pictures in xlsx files are shown
A Home page with recent files, new blank workbooks and templates
Workbooks using the 1904 date system open correctly

description.p: A big step toward Excel parity:

ul.li: Insert and delete rows and columns with formula adjustment; cut and paste moves cells and their references
Row heights, hidden rows and columns, merged cells, wrap text, font sizes, freeze panes, grouping and outlines
Find and replace, sort, filters, remove duplicates, text to columns
Fill handle series, paste special, formula autocomplete and 48 more functions
Conditional formatting, charts, sparklines, tables with structured references and pivot tables
Goal Seek and Solver
Warns before saving over parts of an xlsx file it can't keep
